annotation.title_en: National Program for Artificial Intelligence – Program and Snapshot, April 2025
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel National Program for Artificial Intelligence (Telem; Israel Innovation Authority; Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology)
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Israel's National Program for AI (2021–2026, about NIS 1 billion) aims at global AI leadership. It covers compute, talent, data assets and Hebrew/Arabic NLP, regulatory sandboxes for high-tech, safe AI in the public sector, and international positioning. It also prepares ministries for AI's impact on their domains. Regulation favours responsible innovation aligned with international standards.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five objectives: AI infrastructure and research, high-tech adoption, public-sector AI, global geo-technological status, and national-level preparedness of ministries
Regulatory sandboxes in highly regulated, high-potential sectors
Disciplinary data assets established in compliance with privacy law, together with the Ministry of Justice and the Privacy Protection Authority
Cross-government regulatory knowledge center, regulators forum, expert advisory group, and an AI ethics and regulation principles paper
Active participation in international AI forums and bilateral collaboration with leading countries
